blocks.text: Composites are very efficient and useful modern materials. A composite is a combination of two or more materials that forms a product with better properties. One component is called the matrix, and the others, which are held in the matrix, are called reinforcement agents; some composites have more than one reinforcement agent. The matrix holds the reinforcement, while the reinforcement provides high strength.

An example is fibreglass, in which a polymer is the matrix and the reinforcement may be fibres of a fabric, glass or carbon-based materials. Composites have a good strength-to-weight ratio and strong resistance to corrosion, so they suit demanding applications: boat hulls and car bodies are made of fibreglass, and carbon fibre is widely used in aircraft and sports gear because it is light and very durable. Fibreglass is also used to insulate walls and ceilings from heat and cold.
